    Hello, world! I'm Cathlynn, a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science student who treats every project like a new game quest. I fell in love with programming the first time a line of code made something appear on screen — and I've been chasing that feeling ever since.

    My main quest is backend development: building interfaces that feel alive, with game-HUD polish and anime-level energy. Side quests include Java, Python, and dabbling in game development with Godot.

    Career goal: to become a Backend dev / game developer (and eventually a Mobile Application Development) who ships experiences that make people smile before they even click anything.
